what: Several large uppercase sentences rotate in a single line slot — each letter pops up in turn from 190% below, tilted ±2.4°, at .034s steps (+0~.128s jitter), over .75~1.3s on cubic-bezier(.17,1,.32,1). A sticker image paired with each sentence pops out .12s after the nearest letter rises, pushed 70% and tilted 14° at .7x scale, over .7s back.out(2.2). Letters within its radius (image width ×1.3) are pressed down by up to 12% of letter size .2s later, then rebound over .9s elastic.out(1,.35) and sway ±1.6° every 2.2s. After letter count × .034 + 3.03s, letters drop downward in .014s steps over .22~.4s on cubic-bezier(.55,0,.95,.38), and the sticker disappears with them.

options.[data-fx-part=line]: Ready to write text — at first the inner text is shown as is
options.[data-fx-part=phrase]: Sentences to rotate (hidden). data-key is the paired sticker, data-spot="x,y" is the sticker position (1440px screen px, relative to the center below the title box), data-width is the line width (%) at 1024px and up — the width at which to split into two lines
options.[data-fx-part=icons]: Sticker sheet — inside it [data-fx-part=icon][data-key] graphics, only the current sentence’s is lit
options.rise: Position where text enters and exits (yPercent), default 190
options.min·max: Range of letter entrance durations (sec), default .75·1.3
options.read: Reading pause after fully risen (s), default 2.9
options.press: Depth the sticker presses (ratio of font size), default .12

use: First phraseFirst phrase…
note: The shake is pseudo-random set by letter position, so it is the same every time it opens. If the first-visit loader is running (html[data-fx-loader=on]) starts after that fx:done. With reduced motion, only the first sentence·first sticker are kept

from.where: index.html .dk-hero — original Hero script (six sentences, six stickers, same constants)
